网络科技类.zh: 互联网最大的优势在于它极大地简化了人与人之间的沟通。
网络科技类.en: The greatest advantage of the internet is that it makes communication much easier between people.

网络科技类.zh: 例如，一些留学的学生无需担心思乡之情带来的困扰，因为他们可以通过 FaceTime 等即时通讯工具与家人保持日常联系。
网络科技类.en: For example, when some students study abroad, they would not be bothered by the problem of homesickness, as they can use instant communication tools, such as FaceTime, to talk with their families on a daily basis.

网络科技类.zh: 此外，患有相同疾病的患者还能建立在线社区，在那里分享战胜疾病的励志故事以及有助于康复的实用信息。
网络科技类.en: In addition, people suffering from the same disease are able to establish an online community where they can share inspiring stories of fighting diseases as well as useful information for recovery.

网络科技类.zh: 科技能够有效助力传统技能与生活方式的传承。
网络科技类.en: Technology can positively contribute to the keeping alive of traditional skills and ways of life.

网络科技类.zh: 例如，某些岛屿的人口过于稀少，难以建立正规学校。
网络科技类.en: For example, the populations of some islands are too small to have normal schools.

网络科技类.zh: 教育部门并未通过将儿童送往大陆而拆散家庭，而是利用互联网实现了在线教育。
网络科技类.en: Rather than breaking up families by sending children to the mainland, education authorities have been able to use the Internet to deliver schooling online.

网络科技类.zh: 此外，互联网与现代冷藏技术正被用于保护鲑鱼养殖的传统技艺，因为如今鲑鱼产品可从全球任何地方订购并配送至目的地。
网络科技类.en: In addition, the Internet and modern refrigeration techniques are being used to keep alive the traditional skills of producing salmon, because it can now be ordered from, and delivered to, anywhere in the world.

网络科技类.zh: 尽管如此，计算机技能对幼儿带来的明显益处不容忽视。
网络科技类.en: In spite of this, the obvious benefits of computer skills for young children cannot be denied.

网络科技类.zh: 他们的成年世界将在技术领域持续变革，而互联网正是当今世界所有知识与信息的关键载体。
网络科技类.en: Their adult world will be changing constantly in terms of technology and the Internet is the key to all the knowledge and information available in the world today.

网络科技类.zh: 因此，儿童应尽早学会热情且自信地使用各类设备，并且这些技能将伴随他们整个学习和职业生涯。
网络科技类.en: Therefore, it is important that children learn at an early age to use the equipment enthusiastically and with confidence as they will need these skills throughout their studies and working lives.

网络科技类.zh: 一方面，从某些乐观主义者的角度来看，与外星生命体建立联系可能带来巨大益处。
网络科技类.en: On the one hand, from the perspective of some optimists, there may be great benefits to connecting alien life forms.

网络科技类.zh: 我们的太空邻居很可能会分享其更为先进的技术，帮助我们解决地球上的诸多问题。
网络科技类.en: It is likely that our neighbours in space would lend us their far more advanced technologies to solve a series of problems on the Earth.

网络科技类.zh: 例如，如果我们能通过外星友人的技术支持实现自身进步，环境污染或许就能被彻底消除，威胁生命的疾病也可能得到治愈。
网络科技类.en: For example, environmental pollution could be eradicated and life-threatening diseases could be cured if we are technologically improved by our alien friends.

网络科技类.zh: 更重要的是，在他们的帮助下，人类或许能够取得重大突破，实现超越地球的生存目标。
网络科技类.en: What's more, with their help and assistance, human beings may be able to make a significant step forward to live beyond the Earth.

网络科技类.zh: 这意味着我们将不再担心面临任何可能摧毁我们家园星球的灾难。
网络科技类.en: This means that we would no longer be afraid of facing any catastrophe that might destroy our home planet.

健康饮食类.zh: 政府对医疗保健和医学研究的投资在每个社会中都发挥着极其重要的作用。
健康饮食类.en: Government investment in healthcare and medical research has an extremely important role to play in every society.

健康饮食类.zh: 例如，如果能为幼儿提供更多免费疫苗，婴儿和儿童死亡率就能显著降低，从而为国家发展培养出更健康的下一代人口。
健康饮食类.en: For example, if more free vaccines are available to young children, infant and child mortality rates could be remarkably reduced, which contributes a healthier generation of population to the development of a country.

健康饮食类.zh: 此外，如果政府在经济上支持研发患者负担得起的新药，患者获得适当治疗并因此康复的可能性将大大增加。
健康饮食类.en: In addition, if the government financially supports the research of new medicines that are more affordable to patients, there may be much higher possibilities for them to receive proper medical treatment and therefore be cured.

健康饮食类.zh: 如果没有这样的投资，就很难以低成本为患者提供有效的医疗服务，因为以盈利为导向的企业不愿投入资金进行研发。
健康饮食类.en: Without such investment, it would be difficult to provide patients with effective medical care at a low cost, as profit-driven companies are not willing to pour money into the research.

媒体商业类.zh: 一方面，我必须承认，在媒体的帮助下，了解世界各地不同文化变得异常便捷。
媒体商业类.en: On the one hand, I admit that getting acquainted with culture of different places across the world has become incredibly easy and convenient with the help of media.

媒体商业类.zh: 例如，有成千上万的书籍和杂志（如《孤独星球》）生动地描绘了数千英里外城市中人们的生活场景。
媒体商业类.en: For example, there are thousands of books and magazines, such as Lonely Planet, vividly picturing how people live their daily lives in a city thousands of miles away from the reader.

媒体商业类.zh: 关于当地饮食传统和节日庆典的信息几乎无需耗费时间和金钱即可获取。
媒体商业类.en: Information about their food tradition and festival celebration can be accessed at almost no cost of time and money.

媒体商业类.zh: 同样地，观看电影也能让观众身临其境地体验与自身截然不同的生活方式。
媒体商业类.en: In a similar way, watching movies brings viewers close to a lifestyle totally different from their own.

媒体商业类.zh: 以印度电影为例，它让人们深刻体会到歌唱和舞蹈对印度文化的重要性。
媒体商业类.en: Indian movies, for example, let people know how important singing and dancing is to the Indians.

文史音艺类.zh: 音乐是我们一生中始终相伴的存在。
文史音艺类.en: Music is something that accompanies all of us throughout our lives.

文史音艺类.zh: 童年时期，父母和老师会教我们唱歌——这既是学习语言的方式，也纯粹是一种娱乐形式。
文史音艺类.en: As children, we are taught songs by our parents and teachers as a means of learning language, or simply as a form of enjoyment.

文史音艺类.zh: 孩子们乐于与他人一起歌唱，而集体歌唱似乎能促进参与者之间建立联系，无论年龄大小。
文史音艺类.en: Children delight in singing with others, and it would appear that the act of singing in a group creates a connection between participants, regardless of their age.

文史音艺类.zh: 随着年龄增长，人们的音乐偏好逐渐形成，我们逐渐将喜爱的歌曲视为人生故事的一部分。
文史音艺类.en: Later in life, people's musical preferences develop, and we come to see our favorite songs as part of our lifestories.

文史音艺类.zh: 音乐能够以文字无法企及的方式表达并激发情感。
文史音艺类.en: Music both expresses and arouses emotions in a way that words alone cannot.

文史音艺类.zh: 简而言之，很难想象没有音乐的生活。
文史音艺类.en: In short, it is difficult to imagine life without it.

体育奥运类.zh: 另一方面，许多人认为良好的心理素质在很大程度上决定了体育比赛的结果。
体育奥运类.en: On the other hand, many people believe that a good mentality, to a great extent, determines the results of sports competitions.

体育奥运类.zh: 具体而言，那些志在夺牌的运动员必须在整个比赛中保持冷静，即使面对艰难险阻也不轻易放弃。
体育奥运类.en: More specifically, athletes aiming at winning medals must be able to stay calm throughout the game or not easily give up the game even in an uphill battle.

体育奥运类.zh: 射击比赛便是最明显的例证：在该项目中，专注于靶心且不受观众干扰的能力远比身体力量更为重要。
体育奥运类.en: One of the most obvious examples of this is the shooting competition where the ability to focus on the target and not to be affected by the crowds is far more important than physical strength.

体育奥运类.zh: 举办奥运会能让主办国在经济增长和公共卫生方面获得双重效益。
体育奥运类.en: Holding the Olympic Games allows the host country to reap benefits in terms of economic growth and public health.

体育奥运类.zh: 就经济增长而言，数百万民众会前往主办国观看世界级体育赛事或体验当地文化，这两项活动均能带来数十亿美元的经济收益并创造大量就业机会。
体育奥运类.en: With regard to the former, millions of people are attracted to the host country either to watch world-class sports games or to experience local culture, both of which bring in billions of dollars in cash and create a large number of job opportunities.

体育奥运类.zh: 此外，举办这一国际赛事还能激发大多数民众对体育运动的兴趣，促使他们增加身体活动量。
体育奥运类.en: The other contribution made by hosting this international event is that an interest in sports can be developed for most citizens, and they would become more physically active.

体育奥运类.zh: 从而提升整体人口的健康水平。
体育奥运类.en: As a result, the level of health in the general population can be improved.

政府社会类.zh: 将传统文化作为营利性旅游景点可能会破坏其原真性。
政府社会类.en: Using traditional cultures as money-making tourist attractions may destroy them.

政府社会类.zh: 这是因为传统表演形式必须加以改编以满足游客需求。
政府社会类.en: This is because the way that they are originally performed needs to be altered to meet the needs of tourists.

政府社会类.zh: 例如，在新西兰，为了让观众更容易理解并愉快欣赏毛利哈卡舞，舞步不得不简化，演出也变得更加娱乐化，这种改变最终会导致传统艺术的本真性丧失。
政府社会类.en: For example, in order to help audiences easily understand and happily enjoy the traditional Maori Haka dance in New Zealand, the moves have to be simplified and the show becomes more entertaining, which as a result leads to the loss of authenticity of traditional art.

政府社会类.zh: 职业变动的另一个原因是全球大多数国家的生活成本持续上涨。
政府社会类.en: Another cause of career move is the continuously rising living cost in most countries around the world.

政府社会类.zh: 随着几乎所有商品价格的飙升，那些希望为家人提供高质量生活的成年人面临着巨大的经济压力，这促使他们寻求薪酬更高的工作。
政府社会类.en: As the price for almost everything has been soaring, there is enormous financial pressure imposed on adults who want to provide their families with high quality of life, which drives them to seek better paying jobs.

政府社会类.zh: 据信，实现财务目标最有效的方法之一就是频繁更换雇主。
政府社会类.en: One of the most effective ways to achieve their financial ambition is believed to hop from one company to another.

政府社会类.zh: 私营企业参与某些技术的研发必须受到严格限制。
政府社会类.en: Private companies' involvement in the research of some technologies must be restricted.

政府社会类.zh: 如果允许以盈利为目的的机构自由开展其感兴趣的任何实验，将会引发灾难性后果。
政府社会类.en: If profit-driven organizations were allowed to freely conduct any experiment they are interested in, there would be devastating outcomes.

政府社会类.zh: 例如，核技术并非由私营企业进行研究和开发，而是在几乎所有国家都受到政府的严格管控。
政府社会类.en: For example, rather than being researched and developed by private companies, nuclear technology is strictly controlled by the government in almost every country.

政府社会类.zh: 这是因为人们担心，用于制造原子弹等大规模杀伤性武器的放射性材料纯化技术，可能会落入不法之徒手中。
政府社会类.en: This is due to the fear that the technology of purifying radioactive materials which can be used to produce powerful weapons of massive destruction, such as an atomic bomb, may fall into wrong hands.

政府社会类.zh: 支持居家办公的人认为，这种方式能为个人带来诸多益处。
政府社会类.en: Advocates of working at home believe that individuals benefit a lot from it.

政府社会类.zh: 首先，居家办公能显著节省员工的时间。
政府社会类.en: Firstly, it is time-saving for employees to work at home.

政府社会类.zh: 无需耗费数小时通勤，只需几步即可抵达办公桌。
政府社会类.en: Instead of spending hours getting to and from work, people just take a few steps to their working table.

政府社会类.zh: 节省下来的时间可用于提升工作效率或获得更好的休息。
政府社会类.en: With the saved time, they could do a better job or have a better rest.

政府社会类.zh: 此外，居家办公还能让人们按照自己的方式工作。
政府社会类.en: In addition, working at home allows people to work in their own way.

政府社会类.zh: 例如无需穿着西装，这对大多数人而言并非舒适的选择。
政府社会类.en: For example, there is no need for them to wear suits, which are not a comfortable choice for the majority of people.

政府社会类.zh: 然而，我认为这种非传统的工作方式反而会引发更多问题。
政府社会类.en: However, I am of the opinion that this unconventional way of working causes more problems.

政府社会类.zh: 首先，在客厅工作的人健康状况可能较差。
政府社会类.en: Firstly, people who work in their living room may suffer from poor health.

政府社会类.zh: 由于整天缺乏户外活动，他们更容易患上肥胖症或高血压。
政府社会类.en: They are more likely to be attacked by obesity or hypertension, as they spend the whole day without any outdoor activities.

政府社会类.zh: 其次，工作效率可能极低。
政府社会类.en: Secondly, there may be extremely low working efficiency.

政府社会类.zh: 因为人们容易被零食、电子设备和访客等事物分散注意力。
政府社会类.en: This is because people are easily distracted and disturbed by many things, such as snacks, gadgets and visitors.

政府社会类.zh: 最后，如果所有人都在家办公，会损害面对面沟通的能力。
政府社会类.en: Finally, it damages the ability of face-to-face communication if people do all their work at home.

政府社会类.zh: 当人们习惯了发送电子邮件或进行视频会议后，便难以在现实生活中与他人有效交流。
政府社会类.en: When they have got used to sending e-mails or having a camera meeting, it is difficult for them to communicate with others in real life.

政府社会类.zh: 一方面，有些人认为一个家庭生育多个孩子具有诸多益处。
政府社会类.en: On the one hand, some people believe that having more than one child in a family has a number of benefits.

政府社会类.zh: 其一，父母能拥有更多属于自己的空闲时间。
政府社会类.en: One is that parents can have more free time of their own.

政府社会类.zh: 这是因为孩子们会互相照顾或一起玩耍。
政府社会类.en: This is because children take care of each other or play with each other.

政府社会类.zh: 例如，当哥哥给弟弟妹妹读睡前故事时，父母就能自由地做自己想做的事。
政府社会类.en: For example, when the elder brother reads bed stories to the younger ones, their parents are free to do what they want.

政府社会类.zh: 此外，在这样的家庭环境中成长的孩子更不易变得自私，也更能体验到分享的重要性。
政府社会类.en: In addition, children who grow up in such a family are less likely to be selfish and have more experience of sharing.

政府社会类.zh: 他们更能意识到体贴他人以及对自己的决定负责的重要性。
政府社会类.en: They are more aware of the importance of being considerate and responsible for their own decisions.

政府社会类.zh: 一方面，有人认为当今社会人们彼此依赖的程度更高，这主要有两个原因。
政府社会类.en: On the one hand, there are two reasons why some people say we are more dependent on each other now.

政府社会类.zh: 首先，生活成本急剧上涨，使得生活变得更加复杂和艰难。
政府社会类.en: Firstly, the cost of living has increased so dramatically that life is more complex and difficult.

政府社会类.zh: 以年轻人为例，他们在租房或购房时往往需要依靠父母提供经济支持。
政府社会类.en: Young adults, for example, have to rely on their parents for financial help when renting a flat or buying a house.

政府社会类.zh: 房价已达到历史最高水平，若完全依赖父母，许多年轻人将无力支付首付款和房贷。
政府社会类.en: Housing prices are higher than ever, and if relying on it would be impossible for many young people to pay a deposit and mortgage.

政府社会类.zh: 其次，人们希望为家人创造更优质的生活品质。
政府社会类.en: Secondly, people want a better quality of life for their families.

政府社会类.zh: 这意味着父母通常需要全职工作，而在子女抚养方面则依赖祖父母和保姆的帮助。
政府社会类.en: This means that both parents usually need to work full-time, and they depend on support from grandparents and babysitters for childcare.

政府社会类.zh: 一方面，有些人担心随父母移居国外的孩子可能会面临思乡病和语言障碍等问题。
政府社会类.en: On the one hand, some people worry that children who go and live abroad with parents may face the problems of homesickness and language barriers.

政府社会类.zh: 就前者而言，这些孩子极有可能思念旧学校、朋友和亲人。
政府社会类.en: With regard to the former, these children are very likely to miss their old school, friends and relatives.

政府社会类.zh: 这种负面情绪即使对成年人来说也难以应对，对年幼的孩子而言更是巨大的挑战。
政府社会类.en: Such a negative emotion is difficult to deal with even for adults, so it is a larger challenge for young children.

政府社会类.zh: 此外，学习外语也颇具难度。
政府社会类.en: In addition, learning a foreign language is rather challenging.

政府社会类.zh: 因此，当这些孩子抵达异国他乡后，他们很难立即进入普通学校就读，这很可能引发更多负面影响，例如社交孤立和抑郁情绪。
政府社会类.en: Therefore, when these children arrive in a foreign country, it would be impossible for them to go to a normal school very soon, which probably leads to more negative impacts, such as isolation and depression.

政府社会类.zh: 此外，人们对邻居了解甚少，是因为技术极大地改变了人们的娱乐和社交方式。
政府社会类.en: In addition, people knowing little about their neighbours is because technology has greatly changed the way they entertain and socialize.

政府社会类.zh: 在互联网出现之前，人们会积极参与社区活动以寻求乐趣或拓展社交圈。
政府社会类.en: Before the Internet, people actively participated in community activities to have fun or build their social networks.

政府社会类.zh: 然而如今，邻居们几乎不再见面交谈，因为他们更热衷于在线分享八卦和照片。
政府社会类.en: Today, however, neighbours barely meet and talk with each other, as they are more addicted to online sharing of gossips and pictures.

城市交通类.zh: 精心规划假期旅行至关重要，这不仅能帮助人们节省开支，还能让假期过得更加愉快。
城市交通类.en: It is important to plan a holiday trip carefully, because it helps people to save money as well as enjoy the vacation better.

城市交通类.zh: 例如，人们需要考虑为交通、餐饮和住宿等各项开支预留多少预算。
城市交通类.en: For example, people need to think about how much money to allot for things including transportation, food, and hotels.

城市交通类.zh: 特别是在旅游旺季，若未提前足够时间预订，酒店和交通费用可能会变得极其高昂。
城市交通类.en: In particular, hotels and transportation at peak seasons can be incredibly expensive if not booked with plenty of time in advance.

城市交通类.zh: 此外，如果游客能提前制定详细计划，在一个国家最重要的节日期间前往游览，就能更深入地体验当地文化，从而获得更加难忘的旅行体验。
城市交通类.en: In addition, if tourists make a precise plan to pay a visit to a country during its most important festivals, then they will be able to engage more in local culture and therefore have more memorable experience.

城市交通类.zh: 城市之间日益增强的相似性，是城市人口增长带来的结果。
城市交通类.en: The increasing similarity between cities is a result of the growth of urban population.

城市交通类.zh: 随着越来越多的人选择在大城市生活和工作，政府不得不持续建造现代化高层建筑，以满足居民和企业对更多空间的需求。
城市交通类.en: As more and more people choose to live and work in big cities, the government has to keep building modern high-rise buildings to meet the needs of more space for either residence or business.

城市交通类.zh: 结论是传统建筑的数量逐渐减少，导致城市失去了原有的独特风貌。
城市交通类.en: As a result, there has been a decrease in the number of traditional buildings, which leads to the consequence that a city does not look unique anymore.

教育学习类.zh: 学生行为不良的首要原因是出生率持续下降，导致家庭规模缩小、子女数量减少。
教育学习类.en: The first reason for students' poor behavior is that the birth rate is decreasing so that families are becoming smaller with fewer children.

教育学习类.zh: 一方面，父母对子女的成长具有重要影响。
教育学习类.en: On the one hand, parents have a significant influence on their children's development.

教育学习类.zh: 换言之，教育孩子理解遵守规则、尊重他人的必要性，始终始于家庭环境，且普遍认为这是父母的责任。
教育学习类.en: In other words, educating them to understand the need to obey rules and respect others always begins in the home and is widely thought to be the responsibility of parents.

教育学习类.zh: 例如，如果父母在排队购票时总是耐心等候，孩子也会通过模仿表现出同样的行为。
教育学习类.en: For example, if parents always wait patiently in line to buy a ticket, their children will act in the same manner by imitation.

教育学习类.zh: 相反，那些父母经常闯红灯的孩子，则很可能给社区带来诸多麻烦。
教育学习类.en: By contrast, children of parents who often run a red light are likely to cause the community a lot of trouble.

教育学习类.zh: 早年入学的另一个优势在于，儿童在社交能力方面发展更为迅速。
教育学习类.en: Another advantage of going to school at an early age is that children develop faster socially.

教育学习类.zh: 他们能够结交朋友，并学会如何与同龄人相处。
教育学习类.en: They make friends and learn how to get on with other children of a similar age.

教育学习类.zh: 这种情况在家庭环境中往往难以实现——要么因为他们是独生子女，要么是因为兄弟姐妹年龄较大或较小。
教育学习类.en: This is often not possible at home because they are the only child, or because their brothers or sisters are older or younger.

教育学习类.zh: 然而，那些不允许孩子在校外拥有足够闲暇时间进行休闲活动的父母，其实是在误判。
教育学习类.en: However, the parents who do not allow their children sufficient free time for leisure activities outside school hours are misguided.

教育学习类.zh: 这些活动绝非只是浪费时间，因为它们并不涉及学业内容。
教育学习类.en: Such activities are far from being a waste of time for the children simply because they are not academic.

教育学习类.zh: 我们必须认识到，儿童需要培养的不仅是智力技能，而最佳途径正是通过体育运动、游戏以及与其他孩子一起玩耍等方式。
教育学习类.en: It is important to remember that children need to develop skills other than intellectual ones, and the best way to do this is through activities such as sports, games and playing with other kids.

教育学习类.zh: 如果孩子们无法参与角色扮演游戏，又怎能培养想象力？
教育学习类.en: If they cannot play make-believe games, how can they develop their imagination?

教育学习类.zh: 如果不进行体育锻炼，他们又如何掌握身体协调能力，或领悟胜负带来的重要社交道理？
教育学习类.en: How can they learn physical coordination or learn important social lessons about winning and losing if they do not practice any sports?

教育学习类.zh: 许多孩子会与玩伴建立起深厚的情感纽带；若缺乏这样的机会，他们长大后可能会在情感层面显得不成熟或缺乏健全的人格发展。
教育学习类.en: Many children form strong, personal relationships with the friends they play with, and without the opportunity to do this, they could grow up emotionally immature or unformed.

教育学习类.zh: 支持学生穿校服的人认为，校服制度具有诸多益处。
教育学习类.en: People in favour of students wearing school uniforms believe that it has a number of benefits.

教育学习类.zh: 首先，要求学生穿校服有助于减轻同伴压力。
教育学习类.en: First, requiring students to wear uniforms helps reduce peer pressure.

教育学习类.zh: 当班级所有学生穿着统一的制服时，他们就不太可能讨论衣服的价格和款式。
教育学习类.en: When everyone in the class is dressed in the same way, they are not likely to talk about the price and taste of clothes.

教育学习类.zh: 这样一来，没有人会产生优越感或受到歧视。
教育学习类.en: As a result, no one would feel as a sense of superiority or being prejudiced.

教育学习类.zh: 此外，校服制度还能保障校园安全。
教育学习类.en: In addition, the rule of wearing school uniforms keeps the campus safe.

教育学习类.zh: 因为非校内人员很容易被识别并被要求留在校外，从而降低了校园内发生盗窃或帮派欺凌等事件的可能性。
教育学习类.en: This is because those who are not members of the school can be easily recognized and kept outside. There are consequently fewer possibilities of some incidents, such as theft or gang bullying on campus.

教育学习类.zh: 这些孩子往往被过度溺爱。
教育学习类.en: These children are often spoilt.

教育学习类.zh: 他们可以随心所欲地获取任何东西，且不受任何约束。
教育学习类.en: They are allowed to have whatever they want regardless of price and to behave as they please.

教育学习类.zh: 他们的行为也完全按照个人意愿进行。
教育学习类.en: This means that the children grow up without consideration for others.

教育学习类.zh: 因此，这些孩子在成长过程中缺乏对他人的考虑。当他们开始上学时，尚未学会尊重他人或遵守规则。
教育学习类.en: When they begin to go to school, they have not learned to respect others and obey rules.

教育学习类.zh: 某些地区的危险与荒野环境对普通人而言构成了天然屏障，这正是《人与野》这类电视节目广受欢迎的原因。
教育学习类.en: The danger and wilderness of some places set up a barrier for ordinary people, which is the reason why TV programs like Man vs Wild enjoy a great popularity.

教育学习类.zh: 有些旅游目的地游客可能遭遇绑架或抢劫。
教育学习类.en: There are some destinations where tourists may be kidnapped or robbed.

教育学习类.zh: 而徒步旅行者则极易感染疟疾或禽流感等疾病。
教育学习类.en: There are also places where trekkers are highly vulnerable to diseases, like malaria or bird flu.
